blurb: Beacon Lakes Golf Club offers an 18-hole par 72 lighted golf course and a lighted practice range with chipping and putting greens. They provide various green fee rates including walking and riding options, junior and senior pricing, and special day discounts. The club also hosts youth golf classes through The First Tee program and offers tournament event packages.
